I added `tests/test_refunds.py` with two tests, and both pass:

- **`test_refund_rejects_amount_over_invoice_total`**: with an invoice total of 1100 cents (1000 subtotal plus 100 tax), `refund(invoice, 1101)` raises `ValueError` matching "exceeds invoice total".
- **`test_refund_allows_full_invoice_total`**: refunding exactly 1100 cents succeeds. I added this as a boundary check so the limit can't drift to rejecting the full total.

While reading `refund()` I noticed it doesn't yet do two things the project memories require. Refunds over 50,000 cents should be created as `pending_approval`, and refunds should emit a `ledger.refund_issued` audit event with `actor_id`. I left both alone because you only asked for the test.
Thanks. Heads up: CI runs pytest with `-W error`, so any DeprecationWarning fails the build there even when it passes locally. Keep that in mind for anything you write here.
I'll run the new tests the way CI does, and record the CI setting.
